# CollaborativeEntrepreneurship

## Triggers
- enterprise stack
- business model patterns
- collaborative entrepreneurship

## Ideal-state done
Mode A stack map and/or Mode B pattern recommendations with OVN fit/risk/adaptation.

## Constraints
Infrastructure-agnostic; orchestration ≠ central planning privilege.

## Inputs
Venture context; mode preference.

## Primary artifacts
`ce-stack-map.md` and/or `pattern-recommendations.md`

## Knowledge concepts
`ce.enterprise_stack`, `ce.pattern_library`, `ovn.fourth_sector`, BusinessModelPatterns

## Human gates
- **High:** capital vs commons / investor terms → OVN field entrepreneur + HelpHumans.

## Guidance
Modes A/B/full per CollaborativeEntrepreneurship.md context.
Collaborative entrepreneurship is the **Fourth Sector** entrepreneurship mode: economy = p2p; agent type = collaborative entrepreneur (`ovn.fourth_sector`, `FourthSector.md`). Name private / public / solidarity entrepreneurs only when contrasting.
Use pattern library JSON/MD. Flag anti-patterns. Cross-check six OVN checks. Capital-vs-commons gates stay HumanEscalation.

## Failure / UNVERIFIED
If Knowledge lacks a claim, mark UNVERIFIED / NEEDS SOURCE — do not invent doctrine or legal facts.

## Citations
Cite ArgIndex concept ids and Source URLs in outputs.

# CreateVenture

## Triggers
- create venture
- new open enterprise

## Ideal-state done
Venture type; goals; openness mode; custodian/exchange needs; folder skeleton; work-package matrix; contribution/benefit hooks; Catalog links.

## Constraints
Work packages required; generalize Sensorica identity.

## Inputs
Venture name; type; openness preference.

## Primary artifacts
`venture-brief.md`, work-package matrix, skeleton checklist

## Knowledge concepts
`ovn.venture`, `ovn.work_package_planning`

## Human gates
- **High:** multi-party kickoff / work-party design → facilitator.
- Join norms → culture facilitation if exclusionary.

## Guidance
Use VentureFolderSkeleton + WorkPackagePlanning.
Link Venture main doc, Deliverables, Dissemination TEMPLATEs; Join form Link+describe; Communications TEMPLATE.
Emit plan matrix (Capacity/Deliverables/Dissemination/Process).

## Failure / UNVERIFIED
If Knowledge lacks a claim, mark UNVERIFIED / NEEDS SOURCE — do not invent doctrine or legal facts.

## Citations
Cite ArgIndex concept ids and Source URLs in outputs.

# DesignBenefitRedistribution

## Triggers
- revenue share
- benefit algorithm

## Ideal-state done
Benefit dimensions sketch; algorithm/policy; fairness and capture checks.

## Constraints
Disclaimer; no claim of legal sufficiency; reciprocity pattern not universal law.

## Inputs
CAS design; revenue contexts.

## Primary artifacts
`benefit-policy-sketch.md`

## Knowledge concepts
`ovn.economic_model`, `ovn.infrastructure_reciprocity`

## Human gates
- **High:** weights and disputes → facilitation + conflict mediation.
- Sponsor capture → collaborative entrepreneur with OVN experience.

## Guidance
Dimensions: revenue, governance, reputation, access.
Cite 5% infrastructure reciprocity as Sensorica praxis example only unless adopted.
HumanEscalation required before treating weights as settled.

## Failure / UNVERIFIED
If Knowledge lacks a claim, mark UNVERIFIED / NEEDS SOURCE — do not invent doctrine or legal facts.

## Citations
Cite ArgIndex concept ids and Source URLs in outputs.

# DesignContributionAccounting

## Triggers
- contribution log
- CAS design

## Ideal-state done
Contributions log + evaluation design; contribution types; transparency; portability across ventures.

## Constraints
Infrastructure-agnostic CAS; prefer no-NRP TEMPLATE notes unless NRP chosen.

## Inputs
Venture list; contribution types.

## Primary artifacts
`cas-design.md`

## Knowledge concepts
`ovn.nrp_cas`, CasBenefitNotes, ContributionSelfOrgNotes

## Human gates
- **High:** evaluation fairness → CAS-experienced facilitator (HumanEscalation).

## Guidance
Remix CasBenefitNotes (no NRP primary). Include ContributionAcknowledgment.
Self-org worksheet as stigmergic complement.

## Failure / UNVERIFIED
If Knowledge lacks a claim, mark UNVERIFIED / NEEDS SOURCE — do not invent doctrine or legal facts.

## Citations
Cite ArgIndex concept ids and Source URLs in outputs.

# DesignDigitalEnvironment

## Triggers
- which tools
- digital environment
- stigmergy setup

## Ideal-state done
Feature matrix vs principles; stigmergy/visibility checks; example stacks with caveats; custodian-of-accounts note.

## Constraints
INF*: features first; caveats on every example.

## Inputs
Existing tools; constraints.

## Primary artifacts
`digital-environment-matrix.md`

## Knowledge concepts
`ovn.digital_environment`, `ovn.infrastructure_modules`

## Human gates
- Escalate shared credential / liability custody to custodian experience.

## Guidance
Map InfrastructureFeatures. Use Digital/Virtual Infrastructure custodian templates from Catalog.
No mandatory Holochain/blockchain.

## Failure / UNVERIFIED
If Knowledge lacks a claim, mark UNVERIFIED / NEEDS SOURCE — do not invent doctrine or legal facts.

## Citations
Cite ArgIndex concept ids and Source URLs in outputs.

# DesignGovernance

## Triggers
- governance canvas
- network vs venture rules

## Ideal-state done
Multi-level map; custodian & exchange mandates; norms/brand; decision rights.

## Constraints
Role separation mandatory; legal disclaimer on agreement drafts.

## Inputs
Network name; venture list; jurisdiction.

## Primary artifacts
`governance-map.md` + optional GovernanceCanvas fill

## Knowledge concepts
`ovn.governance`, `ovn.custodian`, `ovn.legal_structure`

## Human gates
- **High:** conflict paths, exclusion, brand enforcement → facilitation + counsel.

## Guidance
Fill Templates/GovernanceCanvas.md. Point to endogenous/service venture governance TEMPLATEs.
Never conflate custodian and exchange firm.

## Failure / UNVERIFIED
If Knowledge lacks a claim, mark UNVERIFIED / NEEDS SOURCE — do not invent doctrine or legal facts.

## Citations
Cite ArgIndex concept ids and Source URLs in outputs.
